description: This file defines the ColumnRange class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically handling a range of columns for spreadsheet manipulation. It includes methods for creating column ranges, shifting them, converting between string and numeric representations, and generating cell address ranges.

classes.name: ColumnRange
classes.description: Represents a range of columns in a spreadsheet, providing methods to initialize ranges from strings, arrays, and indexes, shift ranges vertically, and generate cell range objects for operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ColumnRange object from start and end columns, optionally within a specified worksheet.

methods.name: fromColumnIndexes
methods.description: Creates a ColumnRange from numeric column indexes, converting them to string representations and associating with a worksheet if provided.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a ColumnRange from an array of column identifiers, which can be strings or numeric indexes.

methods.name: validateFromTo
methods.description: Ensures the 'from' and 'to' values are ordered correctly, assigning the minimal as 'from' and maximal as 'to'.

methods.name: columnCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of columns in the range.

methods.name: shiftDown
methods.description: Returns a new ColumnRange shifted downward by the specified offset.

methods.name: shiftUp
methods.description: Returns a new ColumnRange shifted upward by the specified offset.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Returns the starting column of the range as a string.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Returns the ending column of the range as a string.

methods.name: fromIndex
methods.description: Returns the starting column index as an integer.

methods.name: toIndex
methods.description: Returns the ending column index as an integer.

methods.name: toCellRange
methods.description: Converts the column range into a CellRange object spanning from the start to the end columns.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the column range, including worksheet title if available.
